title: Retail Installment Contracts: Payoff Quotes, Closing on Payoff and Release of the Lien
content:
**Quotes.** On Retail Installment Contracts, a payoff quote is issued only for a contract whose status is active, repossessed or charged off.

**Quoted amount and good-through date.** The clause "The quoted payoff is the principal balance plus fees due plus simple interest accrued through the good-through date (accrued interest with the good-through date as the calculation date), and the good-through date is the quote date plus the product's quote validity in calendar days" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for the payoff figure and good-through date a payoff statement quotes. Still in force: a payoff received after the good-through date is applied as an ordinary payment unless it still equals the payoff amount on its own posting date.

**Redemption.** For a repossessed contract the redemption amount adds the recovery file's unpaid recovery expenses, which are paid to the recovery file and never to the contract.

**When the contract is paid off.** The contract is paid off when a payoff or redemption payment equal to the payoff amount on its posting date posts (paid off by the borrower, or by redemption), or when an insurance settlement and an approved GAP waiver benefit credit leave no principal, interest or fees owing (a total-loss settlement); amounts a GAP benefit excludes stay owed on an active contract until paid.

**Lien release.** The lien may be released only on a contract whose status is paid off. Payoff funds become final the product's funds-clearance business days after posting for the paying channel (business days are Monday to Friday excluding federal holidays), and the lien is released no later than the product's lien-release business days after the funds-final date.

**Method.** The release is electronic when the title state is on the electronic lien release schedule; otherwise the paper title, signed off by the company, is mailed by first-class mail to the borrower's mailing address on file. For a total-loss settlement the title is sent to the insurer that paid the claim instead of the borrower.

**Once only.** A lien is released once per contract; a borrower who reports a lost paper title after release is directed to the title state for a duplicate, since the company no longer holds a lien.

| Title state on the electronic schedule | Settlement | Release goes to |
|---|---|---|
| yes | payoff or redemption | electronic release |
| no | payoff or redemption | paper title by first-class mail to the borrower's mailing address on file |
| either | total-loss settlement | the title to the insurer that paid the claim |

**Hypothetical case.** A contract titled in Kentucky is paid off by mailed personal check. Kentucky is not on the electronic schedule, so the signed-off paper title is mailed; the release is due no later than the lien-release period after the check's funds become final.

superseded_clauses: The quoted payoff is principal_balance_usd plus fees_due_usd plus simple interest accrued through the quote_good_through_date (contract_msr_accrued_interest with the good-through date as the calculation date), and the good-through date is the quote date plus payoff_quote_valid_days calendar days;
